title: Glissumo
description: Slide a whole row, ride the sparks, and bring them home before your rival. A two-minute duel on a board you both control, with a solo opponent and instant rematches.
controls: Arrow keys, WASD, ZQSD or the on-screen direction buttons: move.
Up/down: hop to another row. Left/right: slide the entire row, including your rival.
Collect up to three sparks and bring them to your colored edge to score. Bump into your rival vertically to steal one carried spark.
Both players select Ready to start or rematch. Keep the host tab open.
